2607.12383.title: Beyond Binary Detection: A Multi-Dimensional Taxonomy of Cancer Misinformation on Reddit
2607.12383.paper_summary: Cancer-related discussions on social media provide an important space for information exchange and peer support, but also facilitate the spread of misinformation that may influence prevention, screening, and treatment decisions. Existing research on cancer misinformation often relies on narrow definitions, small-scale datasets, or binary labeling frameworks. We introduce a multi-dimensional taxonomy for characterizing cancer misinformation in Reddit discussions of breast, lung, colon, and prostate cancer. The taxonomy captures seven dimensions, including misinformation presence, information type, risk level, stance, and topical focus. Using expert-annotated data, we evaluate multiple large language models (LLMs) for scalable misinformation annotation and analyze cancer misinformation across Reddit communities. Our results show that cancer-related misinformation constitutes approximately 6\% of Reddit cancer discussions, with substantial variation across communities and misinformation topics. Few-shot prompting substantially improves classification performance, particularly for nuanced taxonomy dimensions. We additionally identify recurring misinformation narratives centered on unsupported treatments, distrust of conventional medicine, and misleading claims about diagnosis and screening. Our taxonomy, dataset, and findings provide a foundation for multi-dimensional modeling of online cancer misinformation.
2607.12383.paper_summary_zh: 癌症相關的社交媒體討論為信息交流和同行支持提供了重要空間，但也促進了可能影響預防、篩檢和治療決策的錯誤信息的傳播。現有的癌症錯誤信息研究通常依賴於狹隘的定義、小規模數據集或二元標籤框架。我們提出了一種多維分類法，用於描述Reddit上有關乳腺癌、肺癌、結腸癌和前列腺癌的討論中的癌症錯誤信息。該分類法捕捉七個維度，包括錯誤信息的存在、信息類型、風險水平、立場和主題焦點。使用專家註釋的數據，我們評估了多個大型語言模型（LLMs）在可擴展的錯誤信息註釋中的表現，並分析了Reddit社區中的癌症錯誤信息。我們的結果顯示，癌症相關的錯誤信息約占Reddit癌症討論的6\%，在不同社區和錯誤信息主題之間存在顯著變異。少量提示顯著提高了分類性能，特別是在細緻的分類維度上。我們還確定了圍繞不被支持的治療、對傳統醫學的不信任以及關於診斷和篩檢的誤導性主張的重複錯誤信息敘事。我們的分類法、數據集和研究結果為在線癌症錯誤信息的多維建模提供了基礎。
